fields.note: Search summary: 'Car and Driver's data gives 62.6 inches front and 62.8 inches rear' ('Front Track Width (inches): 62.6'); the guide's specs are stated (AOL republication) to be for the LE. Cars.com's LE page gives 63 in front and rear, apparently rounded (see conflicts). An Auto123 2024 Camry Hybrid LE listing shows the same 62.6/62.8 but is a different powertrain and was not used. No Toyota-published track figure surfaced, and the summary did not say which wheel size the figure applies to. Read from search-result summary; page not opened.

fields.note: Search summary: Car and Driver's data gives 'Rear Track Width (inches): 62.8'; Cars.com's LE page gives 63 in (rounded; see conflicts). No Toyota-published track figure surfaced. Read from search-result summary; page not opened.

Edmunds' 2024 Camry LE specs page: 'Length 192.1 in.' The Car and Driver buyer's guide (AOL republication, specs stated to be for the LE) gives the same 192.1 in. No Toyota-published figure surfaced. Read from search-result summary; page not opened.

Edmunds' 2024 Camry LE specs page: 'Overall width without mirrors 72.4 in.' The Car and Driver buyer's guide (AOL) also gives 72.4 in. KBB lists 72.4 in described as width 'with mirrors' for most trims (73.1 in for the TRD), so the mirrors wording differs between sites but the number agrees; taken here as the body width without mirrors per Edmunds. Read from search-result summary; page not opened.

Edmunds lists the 2024 Camry LE's height as 56.9 in; the Car and Driver buyer's guide republished on AOL gives 56.9 in for the LE. Cars.com's LE page shows 57 in, a rounded figure (see conflicts). Read from search-result summary; page not opened.

Copied from the card research: Edmunds and Autoblog give 3,310 lb for the front-wheel-drive 2024 Camry LE; Cars.com and KBB show the same. No Toyota-published figure surfaced, and the listing sites probably share one data feed (card research checker's concern). The LE AWD is listed at 3,475 lb (see conflicts). Read from search-result summary; page not opened.

Copied from the card research: Edmunds lists the 2024 Camry LE's ground clearance as 5.7 in; the checker found KBB showing 5.7 in minimum ground clearance for every 2024 Camry trim and CarBuzz 5.7 in for the LE automatic. A model-wide republished figure, not specific to the FWD LE; Cars.com shows 6 in (see conflicts). Read from search-result summary; page not opened.

Copied from the card research: Toyota's 2024 Camry release says the car offered 'a 2.5-liter Dynamic Force four-cylinder', the LE's engine; the card research's gap pass read the same pressroom summary as giving the 2.5-liter Dynamic Force with D-4S injection. The card research's checker confirmed the 2.5L four-cylinder substance but did not see the 'Dynamic Force' wording quoted independently. Read from search-result summary; page not opened.

Copied from the card research (fuelType): Toyota's release treats the 2.5-liter and V6 cars as the gas grades, separate from the hybrid; the EPA lists the LE/SE 2.5L separately from the Camry Hybrid and rates it on regular gasoline. The card research's checker found only the ?p=85561 form of this release URL in results. Read from search-result summary; page not opened.

Copied from the card research (aspiration): CarBuzz's 2024 Camry review describes the base engine as 'a dual-injected naturally aspirated 2.5-liter inline four-cylinder' making 203 hp and 184 lb-ft in the front-drive LE and SE; KBB says the Camry 'doesn't go in for turbocharging'. No Toyota sentence on aspiration surfaced. The card research's checker confirmed it. Read from search-result summary; page not opened.

Copied from the card research: Toyota's 2024 Camry press material describes the 2.5-liter four-cylinder; Edmunds lists a 2.5L four-cylinder as standard on the LE. The card research's checker found only the ?p=85561 form of this release URL in results. Read from search-result summary; page not opened.

Copied from the card research: Toyota's 2024 Camry press material calls the 2.5-liter engine a four-cylinder; Edmunds lists it as standard on the LE and the EPA LE/SE entry is a 4-cylinder. Read from search-result summary; page not opened.

Copied from the card research: Toyota's 2024 Camry press material says the 2.5-liter four-cylinder makes '203 hp at 6,600 rpm' (XSE dual exhaust is 206 hp); Cars.com lists 203 hp at 6600 rpm for the LE. 202 hp is the LE AWD (see conflicts). Read from search-result summary; page not opened.

Copied from the card research's horsepower note: Toyota's 2024 Camry press material gives '203 hp at 6,600 rpm' for the 2.5-liter; Cars.com lists '203 hp at 6600 rpm' for the LE. Read from search-result summary; page not opened.

Copied from the card research: Toyota's 2024 Camry press material says the 2.5-liter makes '184 lb-ft at 5,000 rpm' (XSE 186); Cars.com shows 184 at 5000 for the front-drive LE. 182 lb-ft is the LE AWD (see conflicts). Read from search-result summary; page not opened.

Copied from the card research's torque note: Toyota gives a single peak-torque speed, '184 lb-ft at 5,000 rpm'; Cars.com repeats 5000 rpm for the front-drive LE. Recorded as both low and high because no range was published. Read from search-result summary; page not opened.
Same single-point figure as torqueRpmLow: '184 lb-ft at 5,000 rpm'. No plateau was published, so the upper end equals the peak speed. Read from search-result summary; page not opened.

Motor Matchup lists 'a 7,400 rpm redline for the 2024 Camry LE Auto (SE) with the 2.5L engine', alongside 203 hp at 6,600 rpm and 184 lb-ft at 5,000 rpm. A third-party database, not a Toyota figure, and no second source seen; Motor Matchup's 6,800 rpm figure belongs to the 2025 hybrid's A25A-FXS, not this engine. Read from search-result summary; page not opened.

From the card research's gap-pass note only: it says the summary of Toyota's 2024 Camry pressroom page gave '2.5-liter Dynamic Force, 13:1 compression and D-4S injection'. It was not a recorded field there, no second source was seen and no checker looked at it; the summary did not say whether 13:1 applies to every 2.5L grade (203-hp LE and 206-hp XSE) or only some, so treat it as unconfirmed. Read from search-result summary; page not opened.

Copied from the card research: Autoblog has a separate listing for the '2024 Camry LE 4dr Front Wheel Drive Sedan' (and another for the LE AWD); the EPA lists the front-drive LE/SE 2.5L separately from the AWD LE/SE. This record is the front-drive LE. Read from search-result summary; page not opened.

Copied from the card research: Toyota's release says the 2.5-liter and V6 gas grades are teamed with the 'Direct Shift eight-speed automatic transmission'; the EPA entry is 'Automatic (S8)'. Read from search-result summary; page not opened.

Copied from the card research (transmission): Toyota's release names the 'Direct Shift eight-speed automatic' for the gas grades including the LE; Edmunds' LE page lists an '8-speed shiftable automatic' and Cars.com '8-Speed A/T'. Read from search-result summary; page not opened.

Search summary for the 2024 Camry 2.5L with the 8-speed automatic: Motor Matchup's gear table gives 'Gear Ratios 1: 5.25 ... 8: 0.67' (5.25, 3.03, 1.95, 1.46, 1.22, 1.00, 0.81, 0.67), reverse 4.01; 'Auto123 and TrueCar match these for the first four gears and the upper gears'. The summary did not say which Motor Matchup 2024 Camry listing held the table (the results were SE Auto (Natl), XLE Auto (GS) and two AWD listings), and the Auto123 corroboration is its 2024 SE listing, which shares the LE's 203-hp 2.5L/8-speed/FWD driveline; no LE-specific or Toyota ratio table was seen. Yahoo's buyer's guide mislabels 3.03 as reverse. Read from search-result summary; page not opened.

Search summary: 'Most sources give about 2.80:1' for the 2024 Camry 2.5L 8-speed; one unattributed result reads 'Final Drive Axle Ratio 2.802' (TrueCar-style wording, but the summary did not name the page or year), and 'Motor Matchup's AWD SE Nightshade listing also shows Final Drive: 2.8'. The only attributable figure is from an AWD listing, so for the FWD LE this is unconfirmed: no FWD-LE-specific or Toyota final-drive figure was seen. Read from search-result summary; page not opened.

Cars.com's 2024 Camry LE specs list 'P215/55VR17 front and rear tire size' on 17 x 7.5-inch wheels. Michelin's fitment page for the 2024 Camry LE FWD shows an original-equipment-tagged 215/55R17 94V tire; Firestone and Goodyear show the same size for the LE. Read from search-result summary; page not opened.
Cars.com: 'P215/55VR17 front and rear tire size' for the 2024 Camry LE (square fitment). Michelin's LE FWD fitment page shows 215/55R17 94V. Read from search-result summary; page not opened.

Michelin's dealer finder for the 2024 Toyota Camry LE FWD lists a 215/55R17 94V tire marked as original equipment for Toyota 'in an All-Season, Mud & Snow, EV Ready category'. The snippet did not show the tyre's model name, so tyreModel is left unfound. Read from search-result summary; page not opened.

Cars.com shows 37 ft curb-to-curb on one LE page and 39 ft on an AWD LE page (see conflicts). Not a Toyota figure; curb-to-curb vs wall-to-wall basis not stated.
